intro_main_heading: As real estate experts, we guide your way to a new home.
intro_subheading: Our main activity is real estate mediation... but with a twist.
intro_paragraph_1: We don’t just mediate, we actively participate in making your new home a reality. We consider the needs and interests of both the seller and the buyer.
intro_paragraph_2: Our work is driven by expertise, speed, courtesy, and reliability. Our principle is that it’s not enough to just advertise a property and wait for a miracle. Our strength lies in instantly utilizing listed properties for our real and potential clients.
intro_services_heading: We offer a wide range of services to our future clients:
intro_paragraph_3: Our main profile is the sale of properties in and around Budapest, but we are not limited geographically.
intro_paragraph_4:
We also deal with high-value properties, industrial halls, and plots.
For investors, we offer special services based on individual agreements.
intro_paragraph_5:
Only real properties for sale appear on our website, and our listings are kept up to date.
We are available by phone 24/7, and personal meetings are possible in our office Monday through Friday between 9 AM and 4 PM.
intro_closing_message: WE HOPE TO WELCOME YOU AMONG OUR CLIENTS SOON.
intro_data_warning: THE STATISTICAL DATA DISPLAYED ON OUR WEBSITE IS AUTOMATICALLY UPDATED WEEKLY.

career_subtitle: Join a young and dynamic sales team.
career_intro: We are looking for real estate agents to start immediately for selling properties in Budapest.
you_we_seek: We are looking for you if:
condition_1: you’re not satisfied with your current salary and want above-average income,
condition_5: you can use a computer at a basic level at least.
not_you_we_seek: We are not looking for you if:
exclude_1: you need a fixed average income,
exclude_2: relaxation is more important to you than building your future,
exclude_3: you would never give up your weekends,
exclude_4: you are not open to advice,
career_note: It’s important to understand that this is a profession where the effort you invest determines your success. We are looking for colleagues who are fully committed to working full-time.
career_description: There are no regional restrictions or hidden costs. We provide you with a phone, computer, presence on ad portals, featured ads, and all other necessary tools. We mainly seek experienced, invoice-capable agents with certification, but beginners are also welcome as we offer training.
